scopedQualifiedAssessments.qualification: Cell-level assignments, rather than every pooled regional or spot output, require cell segmentation.
The primary method defines a ten-cell window including the centre cell.
The biological size claim is not endorsed. A labelled hypothetical geometry carries the seven-to-ten and 20-micrometre numbers while separating distance from contact.
The universal negative is not asserted. The reader separates locked prospective intended-use validation and approval from these cohort examples.
The report's standardised compartment score has its own evidence; the prose avoids a universal ranking of all spatial methods.
The read full text specifies cell proximity at 25 micrometres, with separate breast and lung microarray results, rather than molecular binding.

sourceReadingLimits: The 13 assigned publications and one additional neighbourhood-method study have complete abstract reads. The author correction has no abstract; its complete two-paragraph body was read.
Research bodies were read at targeted-paragraph depth only. Some retrieved bodies were not used beyond their abstracts.
Crossref initially returned HTTP 429 for Keren; a separately retained later request succeeded without bypassing an access control.
Gide was published online in 2019 and in a 2020 issue. Those dates are kept distinct.
Schürch's correction adds an omitted author; the read neighbourhood method is retained.

The source's biological 7-to-10-micrometre lymphocyte range and universal absence-of-approval assertion are not adopted as verified facts. Geometry is labelled hypothetical and clinical-validation claims are scoped to the cited studies.

No callable Elicit tool was exposed. No new report, question, abstract response or discovery result is invented. Existing frozen occurrences remain discovery inputs, separate from these primary reads.
Non-correction commentaries listed in registry metadata were not independently assessed here.
